step1_analysis.description: A passive RLC network used for impedance matching or filtering in a radio frequency power amplifier. It consists of series and shunt capacitors and an inductor to match the transistor's impedance to the load at the operating frequency.

resonance_frequency.description: The center frequency where the matching network has minimum insertion loss (peak transmission).

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the LC values. For typical on-chip matching at 3.5GHz, L ~ 1-2nH and C ~ 1-2pF. f = 1 / (2*pi*sqrt(L*C)).
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper targets the 3.36GHz-3.65GHz band. The passive component values should be chosen to resonate in this band.

insertion_loss.description: The loss of signal power resulting from the insertion of the matching network, measured at the center frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Simulated S21 or voltage gain at resonance. Ideal LC networks have 0dB loss, but finite Q of on-chip inductors introduces loss.
sky130_expected.reasoning: On-chip inductors in CMOS/GaAs typically have Q factors of 10-20, leading to 1-3dB of insertion loss in matching networks.

bandwidth_3db.description: The frequency range over which the insertion loss is within 3dB of its minimum value.

sky130_expected.calculation: Difference between upper and lower 3dB cutoff frequencies.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The matching network must cover the entire operating band of the PA (3.36-3.65GHz), requiring a bandwidth of at least 300MHz.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure the frequency response, resonance frequency, insertion loss, and bandwidth of the passive LC matching network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* LC Matching Network Testbench

* Component values chosen for ~3.5GHz resonance
.param R_val=50 L_val=1.5n C1_val=1.5p C2_val=1.5p

* DUT
R1 n0 0 {R_val}
C1 n1 0 {C1_val}
L1 n0 n1 {L_val}
C2 n1 label_net_0 {C2_val}

* AC Input Source
Vac label_net_0 0 dc 0 ac 1

.control
* AC Analysis from 100MHz to 10GHz
ac dec 100 100Meg 10Gig

* Calculate Voltage Gain in dB
let gain_db = vdb(n0)

* Measure Peak Gain (Insertion Loss) and Resonance Frequency
meas ac max_gain max gain_db
meas ac peak_freq max_at gain_db

* Measure 3dB Bandwidth
let gain_3db = max_gain - 3
meas ac f_low when gain_db=gain_3db rise=1
meas ac f_high when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1
let bw_3db = f_high - f_low

print max_gain peak_freq bw_3db

quit
.endc
.end
